market_question: Will ByteDance have the highest IPO Market Cap 2026?
reasoning: ByteDance has a realistic (~20%) chance of IPO in 2026 given ongoing discussions, and its valuation ($200B+) would likely be the highest among all 2026 IPOs unless other mega-unicorns like SpaceX also IPO; even then ByteDance may remain top. Overall P(Yes) ≈ 14%, far above the market's 0.1% implied probability.
evidence_points: ByteDance private valuation is $200B+, far exceeding typical IPO valuations, so any ByteDance IPO would likely lead IPO market cap for 2026.
Multiple rumors and reports indicate ByteDance is planning an IPO in the next few years, possibly in Hong Kong.
The market-implied probability of 0.1% severely underestimates the chance of a ByteDance IPO occurring and being the largest.
sources_consulted: Private company valuation data (e.g., CB Insights, PitchBook)
News reports on ByteDance IPO plans
